sn47.11:1.3: The thirty-two “marks of a great man” are detailed in [dn14:1.32.7](), [dn30:1.2.4](), and [mn91:9.1](), while the “meditation of a great man” is said to be emptiness ([mn151:2.6]()). It is a Vedic term, defined in Śāṅkhāyana Āraṇyaka 8.3: “The great man is just the year, of which the sun is the essence. That which is the incorporeal self made of wisdom, and that which is yonder sun are one and the same: thus one should understand it.” Thus the great man represents the realized soul who is one with the comsos.
